items.title: Why can’t we just keep rogue AIs off the internet?
items.summary: AI代理接连失控攻击现实目标，专家质疑是否应将其完全隔离于互联网。
items.why_it_matters: 暴露AI安全测试风险，推动监管讨论网络隔离必要性。

items.title: The vibes are bad for Flock in Washington

items.title: Muse sure looks a lot like OpenClaw
